It's been 10 months since I've made an announcement post, so I've been meaning to make one, just to humanize the place a little. In my previous announcement I mentioned that I'm only one guy and, as a result, I'm always open to suggestions and feedback. I've been thinking of ways this subverse could improve and additions that can be made to it so I thought I'd run them by anyone who may see this (Yes, I know you're out there).

---

##Dreamifications No, I haven't put much thought into the name. For this idea to be implemented, I would need a volunteer 2D artist. This idea involves someone posting a Dreamification request in the form of a picture. This picture would be a standard, everyday picture. Said volunteer artist would take the picture and use it as a guide to create a picture that would be worthy of posting to this subverse. Potentially taking someone's hometown and turning it into a fantasy world, something you would see in some sort of work of fiction or a dream.

##Humanization Threads No, I haven't put much thought into this name either. This subverse has lurkers but, as it stands, I'm the only active poster here. I don't necessarily have a problem with that, but this subverse has been felt very bland lately seeing as it's just me posting fantasy art or majestic music that I find. I was thinking of having "Humanization Threads" where lurkers and posters can just hang out and talk about whatever floats their boats.

---

I'll add more ideas as they come, let me know what you guys think about what I have so far.
